objective: Define the smallest execution boundary after accepted native-parser handoff-contract-to-operator-plan metadata hardening, while keeping this gate definition-only and avoiding command execution, operator-plan execution, RTL simulation, compare execution, measured timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, runtime/ABI change, or native Verilator support claims.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted operator-plan fixture can synthesize a direct-looking Verilator command, but the patched Verilator option path is still parser/metadata oriented and not wired into sidecar runtime execution. A later run gate therefore must execute only a reviewed sidecar build/run/compare sequence derived from accepted metadata, and must not treat command metadata or efficiency_estimate metadata as executed native Verilator support, timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, or automatic GPU allocation.
